title: VulDec: Vulnerability Detection in Binaries via Neural Decompilation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33716v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated vulnerability detection in binary executables is challenging due to the lack of source code and the limited semantic information available at the assembly level. Despite significant progress in machine-learning-based code analysis, the field still lacks methodologies and large, high-quality datasets that provide vulnerable code jointly at assembly- and source-level with precise vulnerability labels. To address this gap, we introduce VulDec, consisting of (i) a new large-scale, carefully curated dataset aligning real-world Assembly-C function pairs with detailed CWE annotations across multiple architectures, and (ii) the first end-to-end framework that leverages neural decompilation for binary vulnerability detection. translated_title: VulDec：基于神经反编译的二进制漏洞检测
translated_abstract: 二进制可执行文件中的自动化漏洞检测极具挑战性，原因在于源代码的缺失以及汇编层面可用的语义信息有限。尽管基于机器学习的代码分析已取得重大进展，该领域仍然缺乏相应的方法以及大型高质量数据集——即能够在汇编级和源级同时提供易受攻击代码并带有精确漏洞标签的数据集。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了VulDec，其包含两部分：（i）一个新的大规模、精心整理的数据集，将真实世界的汇编-C函数对与跨多种架构的详细CWE注释进行对齐；（ii）首个利用神经反编译技术进行二进制漏洞检测的端到端框架。在我们的数据集上微调的基于大语言模型（LLM）的神经反编译器在多种架构上实现了较强的源码级恢复能力（编辑相似度约为56%，BLEU-4约为43%），而我们微调的基于LLM的反编译器……
tldr: VulDec提出了一个大规模、带多架构CWE详细标注的汇编-C函数对齐数据集，并首次构建了利用LLM神经反编译技术实现二进制漏洞检测的端到端框架。
en_tdlr: VulDec introduces a large-scale curated dataset aligning Assembly-C function pairs with multi-architecture CWE annotations, along with the first end-to-end framework leveraging LLM-based neural decompilation for binary vulnerability detection.
